hero.title:
Discover Kenya,
beautifully.
hero.intro: From unforgettable days in the wild to barefoot mornings on Diani Beach, we create journeys that let you experience the very best of Kenya.

welcome.label: WELCOME TO KENYA
welcome.title:
Come for the wild.
Stay for the feeling.
welcome.intro: There is a side of Kenya you can only understand by being here. The hush before sunrise. A herd crossing the plains. Lunch beneath an acacia tree. Salt in the air when you finally reach the coast.

experiences.intro: Not packages. Journeys shaped around the moments you want to remember.

diani.intro: Diani is where the journey softens. Swim. Sail. Eat slowly. Stay out for sunset. Let the Indian Ocean set the pace.

story.label: ROOTED IN KENYA
story.title:
Local knowledge.
Personal journeys.
story.lead: Swathoni Travels is based in Diani Beach and built around a simple belief: the best way to experience Kenya is with people who know it, love it and understand how to make it feel effortless.

points.title: Thoughtfully personal
points.intro: We start with how you want to travel, then build around you.

points.title: Kenya, connected
points.intro: Safari and coast planned as one journey, not two separate holidays.

points.intro: Local support from the first conversation until your last day in Kenya.

purpose.label: OUR PURPOSE
purpose.intro: To create thoughtful, personal journeys that connect Kenya's wildlife, people and coastline in one unforgettable experience.

quotes.text: We came for the safari, but it was the feeling of the whole journey that stayed with us.
Every detail felt considered, from the first game drive to the quiet coast days that followed.
Swathoni shaped the trip around how we wanted to feel, not just where we wanted to go.

hero.title:
Rooted in Kenya.
Made for the journey.
hero.intro: There's something special about discovering a place through the people who call it home.

intro.title:
More than a
place to visit.
intro.large: There's a particular kind of magic to Kenya. You feel it before you can explain it.
intro.p1: In the stillness of an early game drive. In the warmth of a welcome. In the moment the Indian Ocean comes into view. Swathoni Travels is rooted in Diani Beach and inspired by the beauty of the country we call home.
intro.p2: We want every journey to feel personal, considered and full of moments worth keeping.

chapters.title: What moves us forward.
chapters.intro: Three things shape the way we see Kenya, and the way we want you to experience it.

panels.label: 01 — OUR ROOTS
panels.title:
It begins
at home.
panels.intro: Our connection to Kenya is the starting point. We believe that local perspective can turn a beautiful trip into something much more meaningful.

panels.label: 02 — OUR PURPOSE
panels.title:
Travel that
feels personal.
panels.intro: Not simply ticking off destinations. We want to help create journeys that make room for wonder, connection and your own way of exploring.

panels.label: 03 — OUR VISION
panels.title:
Leave with
more than memories.
panels.intro: To help more people experience the many sides of Kenya, from the extraordinary wild to the warmth and stillness of the coast.
